response.overview: The squad prepares for a major change as Captain Holt and Amy get ready to move into new leadership positions. Jake decides to organise one final heist, bringing back the show's famous tradition of elaborate tricks, secret plans and betrayals. The finale ends by bringing back the Halloween heist tradition, reminding viewers that even when their careers and lives change, the squad's friendship remains.
response.tagline: "If this is to be our last ride, then let us go out in a blaze of glory."
response.title: Brooklyn 99:The last day
